title: UI Kit
intro: Controls, patterns and data views for your application.
not_found_body: This address names no page of the UI kit catalogue.
description.accordion: Stacked sections that expand one or more panels of content.
description.alert: A callout that draws attention to a message, with an optional title and action.
description.alert-dialog: A modal dialog that interrupts with an important message and asks for a decision.
description.aspect-ratio: Keeps content such as images and video at a fixed width-to-height ratio.
description.attachment: A file attached to a message, with its name, type and size.
description.avatar: A person or entity shown as an image or initials, alone or in a group.
description.badge: A small label for status, category or count.
description.breadcrumb: The path to the current page through its parent pages.
description.bubble: A chat message bubble for the sender or the other side of a conversation.
description.button: Triggers an action, in primary, secondary, outline, ghost and destructive styles.
description.button-group: Buttons that belong together, joined into one control.
description.calendar: A month grid for picking a date or a range of dates.
description.card: A bordered surface that groups a header, content and actions.
description.carousel: Slides that scroll horizontally with previous and next controls.
description.chart: Charts on the kit tokens, with tooltips and legends.
description.checkbox: Turns one option on or off, with an indeterminate state for groups.
description.collapsible: Shows and hides a section of content.
description.combobox: An input with a filtered list of options to choose from.
description.command: A searchable list of commands, also used as a command palette.
description.context-menu: A menu that opens at the pointer on right click.
description.data-table: A table with sorting, filtering, selection and pagination.
description.date-picker: A field that opens a calendar to pick a date.
description.dialog: A modal window over the page for a focused task.
description.direction: Sets left-to-right or right-to-left layout for the components inside it.
description.drawer: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen.
description.dropdown-menu: A menu of actions that opens from a trigger.
description.empty: The empty state of a view, with a message and a next step.
description.field: A form field with its label, description and error message.
description.hover-card: Preview content shown while the pointer rests on a link.
description.input-group: An input with addons such as icons, text or buttons inside it.
description.input-otp: Separate boxes for a one-time code.
description.item: A row of media, title, description and actions for lists.
description.kbd: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut.
description.label: The accessible name of a form control.
description.marker: Marks a step or point in a sequence, with an icon or loading state.
description.menubar: A horizontal bar of menus, as in desktop applications.
description.message: A chat message with its author, time and content.
description.message-scroller: A scrolling list of chat messages that keeps the latest in view.
description.native-select: A styled version of the browser select element.
description.navigation-menu: Site navigation links with menus of further links.
description.pagination: Moves between pages of a long list.
description.popover: Rich content in a floating panel attached to a trigger.
description.progress: Shows how far a task has come.
description.questionnaire: A sequence of questions with choices, as an assistant asks them.
description.radio-group: Picks exactly one option from a set.
description.resizable: Panels the user resizes by dragging a handle.
description.scroll-area: A scroll container with styled scrollbars.
description.select: Picks one option from a list that opens from a trigger.
description.separator: A horizontal or vertical dividing line.
description.sheet: A side panel over the page for secondary tasks.
description.sidebar: A collapsible side navigation for an application.
description.skeleton: A placeholder shape while content loads.
description.slider: Picks a value or range by dragging along a track.
description.spinner: An animated indicator for work in progress.
description.status-dot: A small colored dot that shows a status.
description.switch: Turns a setting on or off right away.
description.table: Rows and columns of data with a header and a caption.
description.tabs: Switches between views of related content.
description.toast: A short message that appears briefly in a corner of the screen.
description.toggle: A button that stays pressed or not.
description.toggle-group: A set of toggles where one or several can be on.
description.tooltip: A short hint shown on hover or focus.
use.title: Use in your app
use.note: Load the theme once in your application entry with import '@gears-frontx/ui-kit/theme.css'. The example's own imports are in its Code tab.
contract.title: Component contract
contract.note: The kit does not publish component contracts yet. Its type definitions are the reference for each component's props.
